'''L-9''', or '''Ell-Nine''', was a [[Service droid/Legends|serving droid]] that worked at the [[Soft Heart Cantina]]. It was a "trash-can-sized" [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was propelled on wheels and equipped with extendable arms and a magnetic plate atop of its head with which to anchor drinks.
